notes.title: Gameplay Experience Improvements – Version 1.3.1 Update!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156928/1dd51a10cf54f43a8144c035c38eed0b6a197dd9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello players, this is FoxSister.[/p][p]Since the game’s release, I’ve been actively listening to the community’s feedback. Based on your requests and the overall game design, here are the updates in this version:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]\[Gameplay Optimization][/h3][p][b]Endless Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]When entering a bad ending, you will now see a prompt allowing you to decide whether or not to proceed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]True Ending[/b][/p][list][*][p]After clearing the true ending, you may now refuse Nene’s invitation in a new playthrough.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Standard Game[/b][/p][list][*][p]If there is a risk of overwork, the protagonist will now give a warning before carrying out the schedule.[/p][/*][*][p]Virgin protagonists can now trigger the Kyabakura work storyline.[/p][/*][*][p]When asking the teacher to cure the “Host Obsession” state, the host will no longer disappear from the contact list.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now cure the “Host Obsession” state via Japanese-style meditation.[/p][/*][*][p]Reading the Book of Eibon no longer forces the protagonist to lose virginity.[/p][/*][*][p]The status window now correctly displays the first sexual partner.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized game text.[/p][/*][/list][h3]\[Bug Fixes][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some CGs could not be unlocked properly during gameplay.
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We first improved the popular Endless Mode. Since many players approach this mode in a more relaxed way, it was easy to overlook stats and unintentionally fall into a bad ending. Now, if that happens, you can use the prompt to return to normal play.[/p][p]In Standard Mode, if the protagonist risks overwork (low stamina or high stress), you’ll now see a warning message. This should reduce the burden of constant stat management.[/p][p]For the Kyabakura route, we noticed that many players wanted more options while keeping the protagonist a virgin. So now you can work at the Kyabakura without losing virginity. Additionally, many felt the “Host Obsession” state was too annoying, so we added multiple ways to cure it to increase freedom of play.[/p][p]Also, when asking the teacher to cure the “Host Obsession,” the host will no longer be removed from the contact list, preserving the option to call him for H-events later.[/p][p]Regarding the Book of Eibon, after reviewing both player feedback and the text, I realized there was no real justification for it to force virginity loss. Therefore, this event has been removed.[/p][p]Finally, the status window’s “first partner” display has been corrected. Originally, I only prepared four possible first-time scenarios, each with unique storylines. But players found creative ways to lose virginity outside these four, so the system now properly recognizes them.[/p][p]Note: For the Train Molester scene and the Pink-Haired Convenience Store scene, the protagonist will still remain a virgin (the former may avoid penetration depending on angle, and the latter is due to “tiny size” setting). This way, virgins can still trigger these events for added fun.[/p][p]Thank you all for continuing to provide feedback and making this game an even better experience![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156928/b8d416eddbd5b3eac266d78657edb6610a4fc9c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Note:[/i] This update was originally scheduled for release last week, but since it addresses new community requests — specifically enhancing the multi-playthrough experience — it required modifications to the core scripts. This made the update particularly challenging. I worked with the publisher’s technical team for quite some time to complete it, even waking up at dawn yesterday to run additional tests.[/p][p]At this stage, some players may encounter a minor issue where certain small changes related to the multi-playthrough system may not trigger precisely. However, please don’t worry: all original game content remains fully playable. These small changes mainly exist to make the game friendlier to new players and slightly reduce the difficulty. All support features for existing players are already functioning as intended.[/p][p]Once the publisher’s technical department helps us pinpoint the Unity issue, another update will be released to ensure all content is fully consistent for every player.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]★9/26 Update[/b][/p][p]The Unity save issue has now been fixed. From this version onward, both new and returning players should be able to correctly trigger the newly added multi-playthrough changes.[/p]

notes.title: Endless Mode Update – Version 1.2.1! A new hidden costume has been added.
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I’m FoxSister. Within the first week after launch, I updated the game to version 1.2 with the addition of Endless Mode, fulfilling the expectations of many players.
Since its release, Endless Mode has received a lot of positive feedback, and I truly appreciate everyone’s support.[/p][p]To celebrate this mode, I’ve added a hidden costume. By once again meeting the conditions to enter the True Ending while in Endless Mode, you’ll be able to change into the hidden costume by selecting the appropriate button in the protagonist’s dining room.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44156928/7bf05f549e8a2d17586ad9c3e63b178061e77bfb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Endless Mode[/h3][list][*][p]Added a hidden costume exclusive to this mode.[/p][/*][/list][h3]True Ending Route[/h3][list][*][p]The Earth Mother has gained a new hidden ability (applies in both Standard Mode and Endless Mode).[/p][/*][*][p]Added an Easter Egg to one of the CGs in the gallery when clearing the True Ending.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where, under the Obsession status, the protagonist would still go to Shijie after performing extra actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain errors in ending conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed seasonal display errors in Hiberil.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]Some commands have been made more intuitive.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Interface Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character was still shown as a virgin even after intercourse.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some completed missions did not display as completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain CG costumes were displayed incorrectly.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This should now be a relatively stable version. If you still encounter bugs, please report them in the following way:[/p][olist][*][p]Provide a screenshot of the problem screen (including the screen right before the issue occurred is even better).[/p][/*][*][p]Describe the problem you encountered and roughly what you did in-game that triggered the bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Send the above information to my email: [url="https://yoyo12327@gmail.com"]yoyo12327@gmail.com[/url][/p][/*][/olist][p]If confirmed, the bug will be fixed in the next version.
Thank you very much for supporting my game, and I wish you all a pleasant time playing![/p]
